timingAlignment.method: audio-only chroma-DTW correspondences, then affine fit over measure starts 2-15

interpretation: The available guitar-only oracle materially increases reviewed target-pitch salience, including the MIDI50 and MIDI57 classes that the whole-mix Basic Pitch baseline did not match. This supports source isolation as a high-value next component, but does not establish that any approved separator can reproduce the oracle.
limitations: This measures harmonic contrast, not transcription precision/recall.
The isolated asset is a development oracle and is not a product separator output.
The locked Basic Pitch runtime was unavailable in the active container, so no isolated-audio model inference was substituted with an unpinned environment.
Generic guitar isolation does not establish rhythm-versus-lead role separation.
